# Round profile picture

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/round-avatar/

Crop an image into a centered circle and export a square PNG with transparent corners. Choose an output size for your profile artwork.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Turn a square portrait or logo into a round profile image for a mockup or presentation.

## Limits and checks

The centered crop can trim the edges of a wide photo. PNG preserves the transparent corners; JPEG does not.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
